answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 44 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the tundra challenge, the sable audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 2185 identities would post 2025 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
